_comment: Files the game reaches for that a preset MAY leave out, each with the code that copes when they are absent (handled_by + a snippet that must still be in it). Read by tools/web_pack/export_guard.py (make export-guard, in check). A drop that is not listed here fails the check (lesson 239). Add an entry only with the reason a player is fine without the file in that build.

optional.reason: the browser pack's size (round 17 W2 prices bringing it back); the server draws nothing. FactionArt.unit_slots skips a unit whose hull is not in the build, and C6's fallback draws the Condemned's model

the folder is .gdignore'd: AnnouncerVoice reads clips from the real filesystem (load_from_file), so no pack carries them by construction. The booth falls back to subtitles. Web: round 17 W2 is his call. Desktop: W5 ships them beside the binary
only under the developer flag --visfield=reference (sim's measuring arm); never on a player's path
make audio-bench's replay fixture; the bench is run from the editor binary, never an export
